author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
At the Academy's Margaret Herrick Library, Adam examines a small sample of the over 175,000 pieces of production art in its graphic arts collections. Senior Manager Meghan Doherty shows us concept illustrations and designs for E.T., Terminator 2, Aliens, and other science fiction classics. 

Learn more about the Academy Museum and its collection at https://www.academymuseum.org/ and https://www.academycollection.org/
Learn more about the Academy Library at https://www.oscars.org/library

Shot and edited by Joey Fameli
Music by Jinglepunks
